name: tickers_03
prompt:
Search the web now for news on each stock below. You are a financial fact extractor for a
pre-market brief. Brief date: Monday October 5, 2026.

Window: Friday October 2, 2026 regular session (9:30-16:00 ET) through Monday October 5, 2026 12:20 ET, including after-hours, overnight and pre-market news. This spans 2 non-trading day(s): news published on those days (e.g. Saturday and Sunday) is in scope and often the most important. Anything published after 12:20 ET on Monday October 5, 2026 is out of scope.

VERIFIED TAPE (from exchange OHLC data; authoritative, do not restate different prices):
| Ticker | Company | Cap | Screen | 1D close | 5D | Vol× 10d | Vol/gap event |
|---|---|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| KLAC | KLA Corporation | Mega | Top 10 · 1D return · Mega cap | +3.27% | +10.1% | 0.8× | — |
| ASML | ASML Holding N.V. | Mega | Top 10 · 1D return · Mega cap | +3.25% | +7.1% | 0.9× | — |
| TER | Teradyne, Inc. | Large | Top 10 · 1D return · Large cap | +8.00% | +12.7% | 1.3× | — |
| JBS | Jbs N.V. | Large | Top 10 · 1D return · Large cap | +7.46% | +0.9% | 1.3× | — |

TASK
Run a separate search for EACH ticker ("<company> stock news", "<company> shares <session date>").
Find why it moved on Friday October 2, 2026, any after-hours / pre-market move on Monday October 5, 2026, and
other material news in the window. Search press releases (BusinessWire, PR Newswire, GlobeNewswire),
SEC filings, FDA, Reuters, Bloomberg, CNBC, WSJ, Barron's, MarketWatch, Investor's Business Daily,
company IR pages, analyst-action roundups.
If a mover has no company news, check whether another company's event moved it (customer, supplier,
competitor, partner, sector report) and name that company and event.

OUTPUT (markdown; one section per ticker, in the order given; no intro or conclusion):

## Company Name (TICKER) `[Category]`
- fact (source)

Category: pick from AI Compute · Memory & Interconnect · Optical & Photonics · Chip Equipment · Fab & Foundry · Wireless & Mobile · Analog & Mixed-Signal · Power & Wide-Bandgap · Test & Advanced Packaging · Specialty Materials & IP Licensing · Quantum Computing · EdgeAI · Semiconductors · AI Infrastructure · Software & SaaS · Internet & Platforms · Communications & Networking, or a concise sector name (Pharma, Energy, Retail, ...).
If you find nothing, write exactly one bullet: "- No company-specific catalyst found in window" and,
if applicable, a second bullet naming the sympathy driver.

Include when available: catalyst for the move, earnings figures, guidance, analyst actions, contracts
with $ size, filings, regulatory decisions, management quotes with numbers, next catalyst date.

RULES
- Facts only. Every bullet has a specific number, name, or date. No bullet without a data point.
- End every bullet with the named source and publish time if known: (Reuters, Sep 24 07:12 ET).
  Convert every time to ET (ET = GMT-4 / UTC-4 in EDT; 09:59 GMT = 05:59 ET) before judging whether
  it is inside the window. For prices quoted several times, report the latest reading before the
  cutoff with its time.
  "Analysts said" / "reports suggest" without a name is not allowed.
- Earnings: actual vs consensus for EPS and revenue; guidance old → new.
- Analyst actions: firm, rating old → new, PT old → new.
- Mark unconfirmed items (people familiar, leaks, social media, M&A speculation) with [rumor]. A
  Bloomberg/Reuters/WSJ report citing sources is still reportable: state it and mark [report].
- If one event moved several stocks, name every stock and its move in the same bullet.
- Only facts published in the window. Older background only if it is the direct cause of a move in
  the window, labelled with its date.
- Do not interpret price action. Do not write "strong", "beat expectations", "investors cheered",
  "remains", "continues to", "well-positioned", "tailwinds". Write the number.
- Do not write bullets about what you could not find. Omit the topic instead.
- Do not drop facts to save space.
content:
## KLA Corporation (KLAC) `[Chip Equipment]`
- KLA shares closed October 2 at **$206.89**, up **3.27%**; the available report did not identify a company-specific catalyst for the regular-session move. (Yahoo Finance, Oct 2 16:00 ET).[13]
- KLA had an overnight quote of **$209.16**, up **1.10%**, at **20:00 ET on October 2**; no company-specific pre-market catalyst was identified in the available results. (Yahoo Finance, Oct 5 00:02 ET).[13]
- KLA scheduled its fiscal first-quarter 2027 results for **October 28, 2026, at 5:00 p.m. ET**; results, the shareholder letter, and presentation are to be posted after the market close. (KLA investor-relations calendar, reported Oct 2).[12]

## ASML Holding N.V. (ASML) `[Chip Equipment]`
- ASML shares closed October 2 at **€1,661.30**, up approximately **3.2%**; the available report attributed the move to a broader semiconductor-sector recovery, renewed AI appetite, softer oil prices, and weaker-than-expected U.S. payroll data, rather than a new ASML announcement. (Ground News, Oct 5 00:55 ET).[6]
- A report published October 2 highlighted ASML’s expanded cooperation with **Samsung Electronics** on **High-NA EUV** and larger photomasks; Samsung plans to use High-NA EUV in high-volume DRAM production by **2028** and to help develop a **12-inch photomask platform**. The cooperation was originally announced September 8, outside the requested window. (Yahoo Finance, Oct 2 19:47 ET).[1]
- ASML reported **€9.33 billion** in second-quarter 2026 sales, **€2.92 billion** in net income, and a **54.0% gross margin**; management’s 2026 guidance was **€43 billion–€45 billion** of sales and **54%–56%** gross margin. These figures were older than the window and were cited as background to the October 2 coverage. (Ad-hoc-news.de, Oct 5 03:39 ET).[2]
- ASML’s next scheduled earnings release was reported as **October 13, 2026**. (Ad-hoc-news.de, Oct 5 03:39 ET).[2]
- No new ASML-specific after-hours or pre-market catalyst through **12:20 ET on October 5** was identified in the available results; weekend trading was reported at **€1,661.30**, unchanged from the October 2 reference close. (Ad-hoc-news.de, Oct 4 12:24 ET).[11]

## Teradyne, Inc. (TER) `[Test & Advanced Packaging]`
- Teradyne shares closed October 2 at **$449.04**, up **8.00%**; the move followed reported second-quarter adjusted EPS of **$2.47 versus $2.09 consensus** and revenue of **$1.33 billion versus $1.22 billion expected**, with revenue up **103.9% year over year**. (MarketBeat, Oct 2 06:13 ET).[10]
- Teradyne’s second-quarter **AI memory revenue reached $212 million**, described as a record and the third consecutive quarter above **$200 million**; the company’s latest earnings commentary identified AI demand across Semiconductor Test, Product Test, and Robotics as the principal growth driver cited in the coverage. (Ad-hoc-news.de, Oct 4 14:22 ET).[14]
- A Monday market report again attributed Teradyne’s **8.00%** October 2 gain to commentary on **AI data-center demand and hard-disk-drive supply**. (Yahoo Finance, Oct 5 06:20 ET).[7]
- Teradyne’s next scheduled earnings date was reported as **October 27, 2026**, for third-quarter results. (Ad-hoc-news.de, Oct 4 14:22 ET).[14]
- Teradyne had a reported October 5 intraday range of **$444.54–$446.99** as of **09:22 ET**; the available results did not identify a new company-specific pre-market announcement. (Robinhood, Oct 5 09:22 ET).[3]

## Jbs N.V. (JBS) `[Food & Agriculture]`
- No company-specific catalyst found in window.
